summary: Implemented custom global generators loaded by name from the cache folder extensions/generators. Changes: (1) conans/client/cache/cache.py adds GENERATORS_EXTENSION_FOLDER = "generators" and a generators_path property. (2) conans/client/generators/__init__.py adds _get_custom_generator_class(), which loads <Name>.py from the cache generators folder and returns class <Name>; _get_generator_class() checks built-in generators first and falls back to the custom lookup; write_generators() accepts an optional cache_generators_path. (3) conans/client/installer.py (both call sites) and conan/api/subapi/install.py pass the cache generators_path. Not done: no tests added, nothing run (per instructions), no docs/changelog changes in this repo, nothing committed. Design choices to review: built-in names take priority over custom files, and the file name must match the class name.
